title: Markdown RAG Chunker
description: Create RAG-ready Markdown chunks with header-aware structure, token-aware sizing, and predictable run limits.

input_mode.title: Input Mode
input_mode.description: Use text to paste Markdown directly. Use file to load and convert a supported file format from an HTTPS URL or kvs://KEY.

markdown_text.title: Markdown Text
markdown_text.description: Paste Markdown content here when input_mode is text.
markdown_text.default:
# Header 1
Hello, World!
## Header 2
Goodbye, World!

markdown_file.title: Markdown File Source
markdown_file.description: When input_mode is file, provide an HTTPS URL to Markdown, HTML, PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, CSV, JSON, XML, EPUB, and more. You can also provide an Apify Key-Value Store record like kvs://MARKDOWN_INPUT.

headers_to_split_on.title: Headers to Split On
headers_to_split_on.description: Markdown header levels to split on, such as ['#', '##']. Content under headers not listed is merged into parent sections.

strip_headers.title: Strip Headers
strip_headers.description: When true, header text is moved to metadata only. Use true for embedding pipelines and false for human-readable chunks.

max_chunk_chars.title: Max Chunk Chars
max_chunk_chars.description: Optional cap for chunk length in characters. Only oversized chunks are re-split. A common starting point is 1800 chars (about 450 tokens).

max_input_chars.title: Max Input Chars
max_input_chars.description: Hard limit for input size in characters. Runs fail fast when exceeded to protect cost and runtime.

max_chunks.title: Max Chunks
max_chunks.description: Safety cap on total output chunks. Increase only for very large documents.
